annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确将非负矩阵分解(NMF)作为核心方法，用于分解股票市场数据并识别潜在趋势。

annotations.exact_quote: We demonstrate how to impose ap-propriate sparsity and smoothness constraints on the components of thedecomposition.
